digest.component_or_area: blocking-link resolver and dependency graph validation
propositions: Blocking links currently decide comparability from TYPE_TIER instead of parent hierarchy, allowing incompatible tickets to hold dependencies and enabling self-blocking edges.
An epic ended up depends_on its own child while the requested child-level dependency was never recorded, distorting ready, next-batch and parent-first claim cascade for parallel agents.
The resolver must enforce an invariant that no blocking edge can exist between a ticket and its own ancestor or descendant by any path into the resolver.
Existing blocking edges written under the old type-tier rule must be detectable store-wide and repairable in a single pass without breaking the escalation contract.
Auto-escalation of cross-subtree links and the redirect record emission must remain unchanged for existing callers including the link MCP tool and the reconciler's inbound apply path.
